SELECT categoria,
       COUNT(*)                                  AS num_ventas,
       SUM(cantidad)                             AS unidades,
       CAST(SUM(cantidad * precio_unitario) AS decimal(14,2)) AS total_ventas,
       CAST(AVG(cantidad * precio_unitario) AS decimal(14,2)) AS ticket_promedio
FROM "ventas"
GROUP BY categoria
ORDER BY total_ventas DESC
